name: Decode JWT without verification
description: Inspect a compact JWT without verifying its signature, algorithm, claims or authority. Always returns verified:false. Never use this result as evidence of identity or access. Use jwt-verify for trusted-key checks.

token.description: Compact JWT as AString/text, not a hex blob. Redacted from recorded input. Supply either token or tokenSecret.

tokenSecret.description: Secret reference containing the compact JWT: s/NAME or <did>/s/NAME. Supply either token or tokenSecret. A stored token's signature is never returned.

signature.description: Native signature blob; JSON renders as 0x-prefixed hexadecimal. No signature verification is performed. Absent for tokenSecret: a stored token's signature is its bearer credential.
